commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Cage artifact/creature activated abilities by Mairsil ETBs; load graveyard, blink/bounce, haste/untap, copy ability instances, win via cage-specific power/untap/draw.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Bracket 4 — Optimized, tutor-heavy and fast but commander-dependent, not asserted cEDH top tier.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Reject generic Thoracle/Consultation turbo in favor of Grixis cage utility and activated ability kills.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: 99 cards reviewed by cage payloads, grave setup, blink/bounce, copies, draw/tutors, haste/untap, combo payoffs, interaction, 32 lands and colored rocks. Chosen cuts are one redundant defensive cage, one redundant red untapper, one conditional activated-only mana dork, and three lands.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 32 lands preserved. Two slow conditional dual lands replaced with fetchlands, and red Sokenzan becomes colorless Riptide utility; the two fetches improve typed dual choices but do not erase colored source loss. Fellwar Stone and all 3 Talismans preserved.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Retains Aetherling/Essence Flux/Kitten, countermagic, removal and free defenses; gains Riptide/Harpy protection but loses Inkshrouder shroud. Cauldron adds grave hate.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Two fetch upgrades for slower duals; one red channel land sacrificed for instant Wizard bounce; one cage shroud/discard body trades for pay-life self-return; activation-only mana dork becomes Cauldron activated-ability color fixer/engine; red untap redundancy becomes high-power caged Devourer payoff. No mandatory arbitrary seventh.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: 100 physical lines, 100 exact distinct names, one commander, 32 lands, exactly six additions/cuts, Grixis UBR identity, no project exceptions.

verification.evidence_limits: Oct14 approved-source full-list Oracle gate carried forward; newly added six checked with current web source; no new full-100 downloadable Scryfall snapshot or sealed M6 I/J transfer claimed.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: All 99 revisited by role; six net swaps survive loss review including four beyond old two-fetch recommendation.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Second colorless utility land and sorcery-only commander bounce damage reliable Grixis; reject seventh.
Copies cage ETB but loses valuable two-mana colored ramp, weakening casting Mairsil on curve; reject seventh.

larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Second colorless land worsens Grixis access; Riptide covers instant bounce.
Loss of commander early colored acceleration for a post-resolution extra cage.

open_ended_optimization_audit.no_credible_larger_package_reason: The named seventh adds trade much-needed colors or efficient early ramp for incremental caging already covered by Riptide/Harpy/Kitten/Pack Rat.
open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Six material one-for-one swaps are defensible; postfloor 7-swap variants are not clearly better.

low_swap_heightened_audit.weakest_slot_challenge: Considered weak/conditional land, defensive cage and redundant untapper, rather than exempting favorite cards.
low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Devourer and Cauldron added outside old M6 two-land proposal.
low_swap_heightened_audit.multi_slot_packages: Two full 100 seven-swap alternatives examined with exact raw hashes.
low_swap_heightened_audit.no_two_package_reason: Both wider packages add real mana quality loss.
low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Retained Rings, Gilded Lotus and Staff over Reanimate-style generic recursion; found Omen Hawker for Cauldron instead of Fellwar Stone.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: M6 already found mana fixes; independent commander-first protection and secondary ability channel add resilience, while preserving combo core.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Six selected, alternatives rejected; no statistical multiplayer advantage asserted.
